title.sk: Hovädzí vývar so zeleninou a rezancami
title.en: Beef broth with vegetables and noodles

description.sk: Nedeľný číry vývar z hovädzieho mäsa s koreňovou zeleninou a rezancami.
description.en: A clear Sunday broth of beef with root vegetables and noodles.

steps.sk: Mäso opláchni, vlož ho do veľkého hrnca a zalej 3 litrami studenej vody – zo studenej vody pustí viac chuti. Pomaly priveď do varu a penu, ktorá vyplává na povrch, zbieraj naberačkou, kým nebude vývar číry.
steps.en: Rinse the meat, put it in a large pot and cover with 3 litres of cold water; starting cold draws out more flavour. Bring slowly to the boil and skim off the foam that rises with a ladle until the broth is clear.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nekrájaj, len ju rozpoľ a opeč reznou stranou na suchej panvici dočierna – vývar dostane zlatú farbu. Pridaj ju do hrnca s nové korenie, bobkové listy a soľ a var na miernom ohni pod pootvorenou pokrievkou 2 hodiny.
steps.en: Do not chop the onion; just halve it and char the cut sides in a dry pan; it gives the broth a golden colour. Add it to the pot with the allspice, bay leaves and salt and simmer gently, lid ajar, for 2 hours.

steps.sk: Zeleninu ošúp, mrkvu a petržlen nakrájaj na kolieska, zeler na kocky asi 1 cm. Pridaj ich do vývaru a var ďalších 30 minút, kým zelenina nezmäkne a mäso sa nedá ľahko prepichnúť vidličkou.
steps.en: Peel the vegetables, slice the carrot and parsley root and dice the celeriac into roughly 1 cm cubes. Add them to the broth and simmer for another 30 minutes until the vegetables are soft and the meat is easily pierced with a fork.

steps.sk: Rezance uvar zvlášť v osolenej vode podľa návodu a sceď – vo vývare by pustili škrob a zakalili ho. Mäso vyber, nakrájaj na kúsky a cibuľu s bobkovými listami vyhoď.
steps.en: Cook the noodles separately in salted water according to the packet and drain; cooked in the broth they would cloud it with starch. Lift out the meat, cut it into pieces and discard the onion and bay leaves.

steps.sk: Do tanierov daj rezance, mäso a zeleninu, zalej horúcim vývarom a posyp petržlenovou vňaťou. Vývar bez rezancov vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a zamrazený 3 mesiace.
steps.en: Put noodles, meat and vegetables in each bowl, pour over the hot broth and sprinkle with parsley. Without the noodles the broth keeps for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer.

description.sk: Sladkokyslá krémová paradajková polievka s ryžou, ako ju varievali babky.
description.en: A sweet-sour creamy tomato soup with rice, the way grandmothers made it.

steps.sk: Cibuľu a mrkvu nakrájaj nadrobno. V hrnci rozpusti maslo na strednom ohni a cibuľu s mrkvou opekaj 6 minút, kým nezmäknú a nezačnú jemne zlatnúť. Pridaj paradajkový pretlak a 1 minútu ho opekaj.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion and carrot. Melt the butter in a pan over a medium heat and fry the onion and carrot for 6 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the tomato paste and fry for 1 minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky z konzervy, 600 ml vody, bujón, nové korenie a bobkový list. Priveď do varu a var na miernom ohni 20 minút, aby sa chute spojili a paradajky stratili surovú kyslosť.
steps.en: Add the canned tomatoes, 600 ml of water, the stock cube, allspice and bay leaf. Bring to the boil and simmer gently for 20 minutes so the flavours blend and the tomatoes lose their raw acidity.

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar ryžu v osolenej vode 15 minút doměkka a sceď ju. Varenú zvlášť ju pridáš až do taniera – vo polievke by napučala a zahustila ju na kašu.
steps.en: Meanwhile boil the rice in salted water for 15 minutes until tender and drain. Cooked separately, it goes into the bowls; left in the soup it swells and turns it to mush.

steps.sk: Z polievky vylov nové korenie a bobkový list a rozmixuj ju dohladka. Vmiešaj smotanu a cukor a dochuť soľou – polievka má byť príjemne sladkokyslá. Ak je príliš hustá, prilej vodu.
steps.en: Fish out the allspice and bay leaf and blend the soup until smooth. Stir in the cream and sugar and season with salt; it should be pleasantly sweet and sour. Add water if it is too thick.

steps.sk: Do tanierov daj ryžu a zalej ju horúcou polievkou. Polievka bez ryže vydrží v chladničke 4 dni.
steps.en: Put rice in the bowls and pour over the hot soup. Without the rice the soup keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

description.sk: Jemná zahusťovaná polievka s ružičkami karfiolu, zemiakmi a muškátovým orieškom.
description.en: A gentle thickened soup with cauliflower florets, potatoes and nutmeg.

steps.sk: Karfiol rozober na malé ružičky, zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 1 cm, mrkvu na kolieska. Daj ich do hrnca s 1 litrom vody a bujónom a var 15 minút, kým zelenina nezmäkne.
steps.en: Break the cauliflower into small florets, peel the potatoes and dice them into roughly 1 cm cubes, and slice the carrot. Put them in a pan with 1 litre of water and the stock cube and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.

steps.sk: V inom hrnčeku rozpusti maslo na miernom ohni, vmiešaj múku a opekaj 2 minúty, kým nezačne voňať po orieškoch, no nesmie zhnednúť – vznikne svetlá zápražka.
steps.en: In another small pan melt the butter over a low heat, stir in the flour and cook for 2 minutes until it smells nutty but has not browned, to make a pale roux.

steps.sk: Zápražku za stáleho miešania zalej studeným mliekom a rozšľahaj do hladka. Potom ju vlej do polievky a mešaj, aby sa nevytvorili hrudky.
steps.en: Whisk the cold milk into the roux until smooth. Then pour it into the soup, stirring so no lumps form.

steps.sk: Var ešte 5 minút, kým polievka nezhustne a nestratí múčnu chuť. Dochuť muškátovým orieškom a soľou a posyp nasekanou petržlenovou vňaťou. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Simmer for 5 more minutes until the soup thickens and loses any floury taste. Season with nutmeg and salt and sprinkle with chopped parsley. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Hustý zelený krém z brokolice so zemiakom a kúskom syra.
description.en: A thick green cream of broccoli with potato and a little cheese.

steps.sk: Brokolicu rozober na ružičky a hrubú stonku ošúp a nakrájaj na kolieska – je rovnako chutná. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky, cibuľu a cesnak nasekaj.
steps.en: Break the broccoli into florets and peel the thick stalk and slice it; it is just as tasty. Peel and dice the potatoes and chop the onion and garlic.

steps.sk: V hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu opekaj 4 minúty dosklovita, potom pridaj cesnak a ešte minútu ho opekaj. Pridaj zemiaky, brokolicu, 900 ml vody a bujón.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pan over a medium heat and fry the onion for 4 minutes until translucent, then add the garlic for another minute. Add the potatoes, broccoli, 900 ml of water and the stock cube.

steps.sk: Var 12 až 15 minút, kým zemiaky nie sú mäkké. Brokolicu nevar dlhšie – stratila by sviežu zelenú farbu a dostala by kapustovú pachuť.
steps.en: Simmer for 12 to 15 minutes until the potatoes are soft. Do not cook the broccoli longer, or it loses its fresh green colour and takes on a cabbagey taste.

steps.sk: Pridaj krémový syr a polievku rozmixuj dohladka. Dochuť soľou a korením. Tekvicové semienka opraž na suchej panvici 2 minúty a posyp nimi polievku. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Add the cream cheese and blend the soup until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes and scatter them over the soup. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Lacná a rýchla polievka na zápražke s rascou, zavarenými vajcami a hriankami.
description.en: A cheap and quick roux soup with caraway, swirled egg and croutons.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozpusti maslo na strednom ohni, vsyp múku a za stáleho miešania ju opekaj 3 až 4 minúty, kým nie je svetlohnedá a nevonia ako sušienky. Pridaj rascu a opekaj ešte 30 sekúnd.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a pan over a medium heat, add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 3 to 4 minutes until light brown and smelling of biscuits. Add the caraway and fry for another 30 seconds.

steps.sk: Zápražku odstav a za stáleho šľahania prilej 1 liter studenej vody s rozpusteným bujónom – studená voda zabráni hrudkám. Priveď do varu a var 10 minút, kým polievka nezhustne.
steps.en: Take the roux off the heat and whisk in 1 litre of cold water with the stock cube dissolved in it; cold water prevents lumps. Bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes until it thickens.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj v miske. Za stáleho miešania ich vlievaj tenkým prúdom do vriacej polievky – vytvoria sa jemné vločky. Hneď odstav, dochuť soľou a prelisovaným cesnakom.
steps.en: Beat the eggs in a bowl. Pour them in a thin stream into the boiling soup, stirring all the time, so they form fine strands. Take off the heat straight away and season with salt and crushed garlic.

steps.sk: Chlieb nakrájaj na kocky a opeč na suchej panvici alebo v rúre do chrumkava. Polievku podávaj s hriankami a posypanú pažítkou.
steps.en: Cut the bread into cubes and toast in a dry pan or the oven until crisp. Serve the soup with the croutons and a sprinkling of chives.

description.sk: Šťavnaté plátky krkovičky dusené na veľkom množstve cibule, so zemiakmi.
description.en: Juicy pork shoulder steaks braised on plenty of onions, served with potatoes.

steps.sk: Plátky mäsa naklep cez fóliu na hrúbku asi 1,5 cm a okraje nastrihni, aby sa pri opekaní nekrútili. Potri ich horčicou, posyp korením, paprikou a polovicou soli.
steps.en: Pound the steaks through film to about 1.5 cm thick and snip the edges so they do not curl in the pan. Brush with the mustard and season with the pepper, paprika and half the salt.

steps.sk: Na širokej panvici rozpáľ olej a mäso opekaj na vysokom ohni 2 minúty z každej strany do zlatohneda. Vyber ho na tanier – nemusí byť prepečené, ešte sa bude dusiť.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan and brown the meat over a high heat for 2 minutes per side. Lift it onto a plate; it need not be cooked through, as it will braise.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a opekaj ju na výpekoch zo mäsa na strednom ohni 10 minút, kým nezmäkne a nezozlatne. Pridaj rascu, zvyšnú soľ a 250 ml vody a zoškrab výpek z dna.
steps.en: Slice the onions thinly into half-moons and fry them in the meat juices over a medium heat for 10 minutes until soft and golden. Add the caraway, the remaining salt and 250 ml of water and scrape up the browned bits.

steps.sk: Mäso vráť do panvice, prikry ho cibuľou a dus pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 40 až 45 minút, kým nie je mäkké a vidlička ním ľahko prejde. Ak sa voda odparí, podlej.
steps.en: Return the meat to the pan, cover it with the onions and braise, covered, over a low heat for 40 to 45 minutes until tender and a fork slides in easily. Add water if it evaporates.

steps.sk: Medzitým ošúp zemiaky a uvar ich v osolenej vode 20 minút doměkka. Mäso podávaj s cibuľovou šťavou a zemiakmi posypanými petržlenovou vňaťou.
steps.en: Meanwhile peel the potatoes and boil them in salted water for 20 minutes until tender. Serve the meat with the onion gravy and the potatoes sprinkled with parsley.

title.en: Baked potatoes stuffed with ham and cheese

description.sk: Pečené zemiaky vydlabané a naplnené kašou so šunkou, cibuľkou a syrom.
description.en: Baked potatoes scooped out and filled with a mash of ham, spring onion and cheese.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Zemiaky dôkladne umy kefkou, osuš, niekoľkokrát prepichni vidličkou a ulož priamo na mriežku. Peč 50 až 60 minút, kým nôž hladko nevojde do stredu.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Scrub the potatoes well, dry them, prick several times with a fork and place them straight on the oven rack. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes until a knife slides smoothly into the centre.

steps.sk: Kým sa zemiaky pečú, nakrájaj šunku na drobné kocky, jarnú cibuľku na kolieska a syr nastrúhaj.
steps.en: While the potatoes bake, dice the ham small, slice the spring onions and grate the cheese.

steps.sk: Horúce zemiaky rozkroj pozdĺžne napoly a lyžicou vyber dužinu tak, aby po okrajoch zostala asi 5 mm vrstva. Dužinu roztlač s maslom, kyslou smotanou, soľou a korením a vmiešaj šunku, cibuľku a polovicu syra.
steps.en: Halve the hot potatoes lengthways and scoop out the flesh with a spoon, leaving a shell about 5 mm thick. Mash the flesh with the butter, sour cream, salt and pepper and stir in the ham, spring onion and half the cheese.

steps.sk: Zmesou naplň šupky, posyp zvyšným syrom a paprikou a zapekaj 15 minút, kým syr nie je roztopený a zlatistý. Podávaj s uhorkovým alebo zeleninovým šalátom.
steps.en: Pile the mixture back into the skins, sprinkle with the remaining cheese and the paprika and bake for 15 minutes until the cheese is melted and golden. Serve with a cucumber or green salad.

title.en: Moravian roast pork with braised cabbage

description.sk: Kúsky bravčového pliecka pečené s cesnakom a rascou, s kyslou dusenou kapustou.
description.en: Pieces of pork shoulder roasted with garlic and caraway, with sour braised cabbage.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky asi 4 cm. V miske ho premiešaj s prelisovaným cesnakom, rascou a soľou a nechaj aspoň 15 minút postáť. Rúru predhrej na 180 °C.
steps.en: Cut the meat into roughly 4 cm cubes. Mix it in a bowl with the crushed garlic, caraway and salt and leave for at least 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 180 °C.

steps.sk: Jednu cibuľu nakrájaj na mesiačiky a rozlož na dno pekáča. Navrch daj mäso, pridaj lyžicu masti a 150 ml vody, prikry alobalom a peč 60 minút.
steps.en: Cut one onion into wedges and spread over the base of a roasting tin. Put the meat on top, add a spoonful of lard and 150 ml of water, cover with foil and roast for 60 minutes.

steps.sk: Alobal odstráň, mäso premiešaj a peč odkryté ďalších 30 minút, kým nie je mäkké a navrchu zlatohnedé. Vždy po 10 minútach ho polej šťavou z pekáča.
steps.en: Remove the foil, stir the meat and roast uncovered for another 30 minutes until tender and golden brown on top. Baste it with the pan juices every 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Medzitým na zvyšnej masti opeč nadrobno nakrájanú druhú cibuľu dozlatista, pridaj scedenú kapustu, 150 ml vody a cukor a dus pod pokrievkou 30 minút. Na konci posyp múkou, premiešaj a var ešte 3 minúty, aby kapusta zhustla.
steps.en: Meanwhile fry the second onion, finely chopped, in the rest of the lard until golden, add the drained sauerkraut, 150 ml of water and the sugar and braise, covered, for 30 minutes. At the end sprinkle with the flour, stir and cook for 3 more minutes to thicken.

steps.sk: Vrabca podávaj so šťavou z pekáča, kapustou a pečivom alebo knedľou. Zvyšky vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a zohriate chutia ešte lepšie.
steps.en: Serve the pork with the pan juices, the cabbage and bread rolls or dumplings. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 3 days and taste even better reheated.

description.sk: Český hovädzí guláš s nakladanými uhorkami a cibuľou, s ryžou alebo knedľou.
description.en: A Czech beef goulash with pickles and onion, served with rice or dumplings.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm a osuš ho. Na oleji v hrnci ho opekaj na vysokom ohni po častiach, aby sa neparilo, kým nie je zo všetkých strán hnedé. Vyber ho na tanier.
steps.en: Cut the meat into roughly 3 cm cubes and pat dry. Brown it in batches in the oil in a pot over a high heat so it does not steam, until browned on all sides. Lift onto a plate.

steps.sk: Na výpekoch opekaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 10 minút na strednom ohni do zlatista. Pridaj pretlak a papriku, krátko premiešaj a hneď podlej 100 ml vody, aby paprika nezhorkla.
steps.en: Fry the finely chopped onions in the juices over a medium heat for 10 minutes until golden. Add the tomato paste and paprika, stir briefly and immediately add 100 ml of water so the paprika does not turn bitter.

steps.sk: Vráť mäso, pridaj bobkové listy, soľ, korenie a 600 ml vody. Dus pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 80 až 90 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké a rozpadá sa pod vidličkou.
steps.en: Return the meat and add the bay leaves, salt, pepper and 600 ml of water. Braise, covered, over a low heat for 80 to 90 minutes until the meat is tender and falls apart under a fork.

steps.sk: Múku rozmiešaj v 3 lyžiciach studenej vody a vmiešaj do gulášu. Pridaj uhorky nakrájané na prúžky a lyžicu nálevu z nich a var ešte 5 minút, kým šťava nezhustne. Medzitým uvar ryžu.
steps.en: Mix the flour with 3 tablespoons of cold water and stir into the goulash. Add the pickles cut into strips and a spoonful of their brine and simmer for 5 more minutes until the sauce thickens. Meanwhile cook the rice.

steps.sk: Guláš podávaj s ryžou alebo knedľou. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni, zamrazený 3 mesiace – na druhý deň je najlepší.
steps.en: Serve the goulash with rice or dumplings. It keeps for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer, and is best the next day.

title.en: Potato dumplings filled with smoked meat

description.sk: Knedle zo zemiakového cesta s plnkou z údeného mäsa a cibule, s kapustou.
description.en: Potato dough dumplings filled with smoked meat and onion, served with cabbage.

note.sk: do cesta; vodu na varenie osoľ podľa chuti
note.en: for the dough; salt the cooking water to taste

steps.sk: Zemiaky uvar v šupke doměkka, asi 25 minút, ošúp ich a ešte teplé prelisuj alebo pretlač. Nechaj ich úplne vychladnúť – z teplých zemiakov by cesto bolo lepkavé a potrebovalo by priveľa múky.
steps.en: Boil the potatoes in their skins until tender, about 25 minutes, peel them and press or rice them while warm. Let them cool completely; warm potatoes make a sticky dough that needs too much flour.

steps.sk: Na plnku nakrájaj mäso na drobné kocky, cibuľu nadrobno a opeč ich spolu na masti 5 minút. Kapustu zalej 100 ml vody, pridaj rascu a dus 20 minút pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: For the filling dice the meat small and chop the onion finely, then fry them together in the lard for 5 minutes. Cover the sauerkraut with 100 ml of water, add the caraway and braise, covered, for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: K vychladnutým zemiakom pridaj vajce, krupicu, soľ a múku a rýchlo vypracuj vláčne cesto. Rozdeľ ho na 12 kúskov, každý rozplošti na dlani, daj doň lyžicu plnky a uzavri do guľky.
steps.en: Add the egg, semolina, salt and flour to the cooled potatoes and quickly work into a soft dough. Divide it into 12 pieces, flatten each in your palm, add a spoonful of filling and seal into a ball.

steps.sk: Knedle vkladaj do veľkého hrnca s mierne vriacou osolenou vodou, hneď ich odlep od dna a var 12 minút od vyplávania. Voda nesmie prudko vrieť, knedle by sa rozpadli.
steps.en: Drop the dumplings into a large pan of gently simmering salted water, loosen them from the bottom straight away and cook for 12 minutes from when they float. The water must not boil hard or they fall apart.

steps.sk: Knedle vyber dierovanou naberačkou, podávaj ich s dusenou kapustou a polej ich výpekom z mäsa z panvice. Zvyšky knedlí na druhý deň nakrájaj a opeč na masti s vajcom.
steps.en: Lift the dumplings out with a slotted spoon, serve with the braised cabbage and drizzle with the meat dripping from the pan. The next day slice any leftover dumplings and fry them in lard with egg.

title.en: Split pea purée with fried onions

description.sk: Hustá kaša z hrachu s chrumkavou cibuľou a kyslou uhorkou, sýta a lacná.
description.en: A thick split pea purée with crisp onions and a pickle, filling and cheap.

steps.sk: Hrach prepláchni a namoč aspoň na 2 hodiny alebo cez noc – rýchlejšie zmäkne. Potom ho sceď, zalej 1,2 litrom vody, pridaj bobkový list a var na miernom ohni 45 až 60 minút doměkka.
steps.en: Rinse the split peas and soak them for at least 2 hours or overnight so they soften faster. Then drain, cover with 1.2 litres of water, add the bay leaf and simmer for 45 to 60 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Hrach počas varenia občas premiešaj a penu zbieraj. Ak sa voda odparí skôr, než zmäkne, podlej horúcou vodou. Hotový je, keď sa rozpadá na kašu.
steps.en: Stir the peas now and then as they cook and skim off the foam. If the water evaporates before they soften, top up with hot water. They are done when they fall apart into a purée.

steps.sk: Bobkový list vyber, pridaj soľ, prelisovaný cesnak a majorán a hrach rozmixuj alebo roztlač na hladkú kašu. Ak je príliš hustá, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Remove the bay leaf, add the salt, crushed garlic and marjoram and blend or mash the peas into a smooth purée. Add a little water if it is too thick.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a opekaj ju na oleji na strednom ohni 10 minút do zlatohnedej a chrumkavej. Kašu rozdeľ na taniere, navrch daj cibuľku aj s olejom a podávaj s uhorkou a chlebom.
steps.en: Slice the onions thinly into half-moons and fry them in the oil over a medium heat for 10 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Divide the purée between plates, top with the onions and their oil and serve with pickles and bread.

title.sk: Bravčové ražniči s cibuľou a slaninou
title.en: Pork ražniči skewers with onion and bacon

description.sk: Špízy z bravčového mäsa, slaniny, cibule a papriky, upečené v rúre alebo na grile.
description.en: Skewers of pork, bacon, onion and pepper, cooked in the oven or on the grill.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm. Zmiešaj olej, papriku, prelisovaný cesnak, soľ a korenie a mäso v tejto marináde dôkladne obaľ. Nechaj ho aspoň 30 minút marinovať v chladničke.
steps.en: Cut the meat into roughly 3 cm cubes. Mix the oil, paprika, crushed garlic, salt and pepper and coat the meat thoroughly in this marinade. Marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na štvrtiny a rozober na vrstvy, papriku na štvorce asi 3 cm a slaninu na kúsky. Ak používaš drevené špajdle, namoč ich na 20 minút do vody.
steps.en: Cut the onions into quarters and separate the layers, the peppers into 3 cm squares and the bacon into pieces. If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Na špajdle napichuj striedavo mäso, slaninu, cibuľu a papriku tesne vedľa seba. Rúru predhrej na 220 °C a špízy ulož na mriežku nad plech, kam bude stekať šťava.
steps.en: Thread the meat, bacon, onion and pepper alternately onto the skewers, packed closely. Preheat the oven to 220 °C and lay the skewers on a rack over a tray to catch the juices.

steps.sk: Peč 20 až 25 minút, v polovici ich otoč a potri zvyškom marinády. Mäso je hotové, keď je vo vnútri biele bez ružovej farby a šťava je číra. Medzitým uvar zemiaky.
steps.en: Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, turning halfway and brushing with the rest of the marinade. The meat is done when white inside with no pink and the juices run clear. Meanwhile boil the potatoes.

steps.sk: Ražniči podávaj so zemiakmi, horčicou a čerstvou zeleninou. Studené mäso z špízov je dobré aj do šalátu na druhý deň.
steps.en: Serve the skewers with the potatoes, mustard and fresh vegetables. Leftover cold meat is good in a salad the next day.

description.sk: Česká sladkokyslá paradajková omáčka s korením a dusenou hovädzinou.
description.en: A Czech sweet-sour tomato sauce with spices and braised beef.

steps.sk: Mäso vlož do hrnca, zalej 1,2 litrom vody, pridaj soľ, nové korenie a bobkové listy a var na miernom ohni 90 minút, kým nie je mäkké. Penu na začiatku zbieraj. Vývar si odlož, budeš ho potrebovať.
steps.en: Put the meat in a pot, cover with 1.2 litres of water, add the salt, allspice and bay leaves and simmer gently for 90 minutes until tender. Skim the foam at the start. Keep the broth; you will need it.

steps.sk: Cibuľu, mrkvu a petržlen nakrájaj nadrobno a opeč ich na masle 8 minút do zlatista. Posyp múkou, opekaj 2 minúty, pridaj pretlak a krátko premiešaj.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion, carrot and parsley root and fry them in the butter for 8 minutes until golden. Sprinkle with the flour, cook for 2 minutes, add the tomato paste and stir briefly.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, 500 ml vývaru, škoricu, cukor a ocot a var na miernom ohni 20 minút. Omáčka by mala byť výrazne sladkokyslá – podľa chuti uprav cukrom a octom.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, 500 ml of the broth, the cinnamon, sugar and vinegar and simmer gently for 20 minutes. The sauce should be distinctly sweet and sour; adjust with sugar and vinegar to taste.

steps.sk: Škoricu vyber a omáčku rozmixuj dohladka. Ak je hustá, zrieď ju vývarom. Mäso nakrájaj na plátky naprieč vláknami a vlož ho do omáčky, aby sa v nej 5 minút prehrialo.
steps.en: Remove the cinnamon and blend the sauce until smooth. If it is thick, thin it with broth. Slice the meat across the grain and put it into the sauce to warm through for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Podávaj s knedľou alebo cestovinami. Omáčka s mäsom vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Serve with bread dumplings or pasta. The sauce with the meat keeps in the fridge for 4 days and can be frozen.

description.sk: Kaleráby plnené mletým mäsom s ryžou, dusené v smotanovej omáčke s kôprom.
description.en: Kohlrabi stuffed with minced meat and rice, braised in a creamy dill sauce.

steps.sk: Kaleráby ošúp, odrež vrch a lyžičkou alebo nožom ich vydlab tak, aby steny mali asi 1 cm. Vydlabanú dužinu nakrájaj na kocky – pôjde do omáčky.
steps.en: Peel the kohlrabi, cut off the tops and hollow them out with a spoon or knife, leaving walls about 1 cm thick. Dice the scooped flesh; it goes into the sauce.

steps.sk: Ryžu uvar 10 minút napoly a sceď. Mäso zmiešaj s ryžou, vajcom, nadrobno nasekanou cibuľou, soľou a korením. Kaleráby naplň mäsom, aj s malou kôpkou navrchu.
steps.en: Par-boil the rice for 10 minutes and drain. Mix the meat with the rice, egg, finely chopped onion, salt and pepper. Fill the kohlrabi with the meat, mounding it slightly on top.

steps.sk: Kaleráby postav do hrnca, okolo nich rozsyp kocky dužiny a zalej 500 ml vody s bujónom tak, aby siahala do polovice. Dus pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 45 minút, kým nôž ľahko vojde do kalerábu a mäso je prepečené.
steps.en: Stand the kohlrabi in a pan, scatter the diced flesh around them and pour in 500 ml of water with the stock cube to come halfway up. Braise, covered, over a low heat for 45 minutes until a knife slides easily into the kohlrabi and the meat is cooked through.

steps.sk: Kaleráby vyber na tanier. Smotanu rozšľahaj s múkou, vlej do šťavy a var za stáleho miešania 5 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne. Vmiešaj nasekaný kôpor.
steps.en: Lift the kohlrabi onto a plate. Whisk the cream with the flour, pour it into the cooking liquid and simmer, stirring, for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens. Stir in the chopped dill.

steps.sk: Kaleráby vráť do omáčky a podávaj so zemiakmi alebo chlebom. Vydržia v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Return the kohlrabi to the sauce and serve with potatoes or bread. They keep in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Ružičky karfiolu v chrumkavom trojobale, s varenými zemiakmi a tatárskou omáčkou.
description.en: Cauliflower florets in a crisp breadcrumb coating with boiled potatoes and tartare sauce.

note.sk: toľko vsiakne; na vyprážanie priprav asi 400 ml
note.en: this much is absorbed; have about 400 ml for frying

steps.sk: Karfiol rozober na ružičky veľké asi ako vlašský orech a var ich v osolenej vode 4 minúty, aby zmäkli, ale nerozpadali sa. Sceď ich a nechaj vychladnúť a odpariť – mokré by obal neudržali.
steps.en: Break the cauliflower into walnut-sized florets and boil them in salted water for 4 minutes so they soften without falling apart. Drain and let them cool and steam dry; wet florets will not hold the coating.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a uvar v osolenej vode 20 minút doměkka. Na tatársku omáčku zmiešaj majonézu s jogurtom a nadrobno nakrájanými uhorkami.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and boil them in salted water for 20 minutes until tender. For the tartare sauce mix the mayonnaise with the yogurt and finely chopped pickles.

steps.sk: Priprav tri misky: múku, vajcia rozšľahané so štipkou soli a strúhanku. Každú ružičku obaľ v múke, vajci a strúhanke a obal pritlač, aby dobre držal.
steps.en: Set out three bowls: flour, eggs beaten with a pinch of salt, and breadcrumbs. Coat each floret in flour, egg and crumbs and press the coating on so it holds.

steps.sk: V hlbšej panvici rozpáľ olej na strednom až vysokom ohni – je dosť horúci, keď okolo kúska chleba hneď zasyčí. Vyprážaj karfiol po častiach 3 až 4 minúty, kým nie je zlatohnedý, a vyberaj ho na papierovú utierku.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a deep pan over a medium-high heat; it is hot enough when a crumb of bread sizzles at once. Fry the cauliflower in batches for 3 to 4 minutes until golden brown and drain on kitchen paper.

steps.sk: Podávaj hneď so zemiakmi a tatárskou omáčkou, kým je obal chrumkavý. Zvyšky sa dajú prehriať v rúre pri 200 °C, v mikrovlnke by zmäkli.
steps.en: Serve at once with the potatoes and tartare sauce while the coating is crisp. Leftovers reheat in the oven at 200 °C; in the microwave they turn soggy.

description.sk: Pečené stehná so slovenskou plnkou zo žemlí, vajec, šunky a petržlenovej vňate.
description.en: Roast chicken legs with Slovak stuffing of rolls, eggs, ham and parsley.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Stehná osuš, potri ich paprikou, polovicou soli a korením a ulož kožou nahor na jednu stranu väčšieho pekáča.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Pat the chicken dry, rub with the paprika, half the salt and the pepper and lay skin side up on one side of a large roasting tin.

steps.sk: Žemle nakrájaj na kocky asi 1 cm a zalej ich mliekom rozšľahaným s vajcami. Nechaj 10 minút nasiaknuť. Medzitým nakrájaj šunku na drobné kocky a nasekaj petržlenovú vňať.
steps.en: Cut the rolls into roughly 1 cm cubes and pour over the milk beaten with the eggs. Leave to soak for 10 minutes. Meanwhile dice the ham small and chop the parsley.

steps.sk: K žemliam pridaj šunku, vňať, rozpustené maslo, muškátový oriešok a zvyšnú soľ a premiešaj. Plnku rozotri do vymastenej druhej polovice pekáča alebo do menšej formy vo vrstve hrubej asi 4 cm.
steps.en: Add the ham, parsley, melted butter, nutmeg and remaining salt to the rolls and mix. Spread the stuffing in the greased other half of the tin, or in a smaller dish, about 4 cm deep.

steps.sk: Peč 45 až 50 minút, kým nie je koža stehien chrumkavá a zlatohnedá a plnka navrchu opečená. Stehná sú hotové, keď pri prepichnutí pri kosti vyteká číra šťava, nie ružová.
steps.en: Roast for 45 to 50 minutes until the chicken skin is crisp and golden brown and the stuffing is browned on top. The chicken is done when the juices run clear, not pink, when pierced near the bone.

steps.sk: Podávaj stehná s plnkou nakrájanou na kocky a so šťavou z pekáča, k tomu kompót alebo zeleninový šalát. Plnka je dobrá aj studená.
steps.en: Serve the chicken with the stuffing cut into squares and the pan juices, with stewed fruit or a green salad. The stuffing is good cold too.

description.sk: Zemiakové halušky s mäkkým tvarohom, opečenou slaninou a pažítkou.
description.en: Potato halušky with soft quark, crispy bacon and chives.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nastrúhaj na najjemnejšom strúhadle. Ak pustia veľa vody, časť zlej. Pridaj vajce, polovicu soli a múku a vymiešaj husté lepivé cesto, ktoré pomaly steká z lyžice.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and grate them on the finest grater. If they release a lot of water, pour some off. Add the egg, half the salt and the flour and mix into a thick, sticky batter that drops slowly from a spoon.

steps.sk: Slaninu nakrájaj na kocky a na suchej panvici ju pomaly opekaj na strednom ohni 6 až 8 minút, kým nepustí tuk a nie je chrumkavá. Tvaroh vymiešaj s kyslou smotanou.
steps.en: Dice the bacon and fry it slowly in a dry pan over a medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes until it releases its fat and turns crisp. Mix the quark with the sour cream.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci priveď do varu osolenú vodu. Cesto pretláčaj cez haluškovač alebo ho z dosky odrezávaj nožom priamo do vriacej vody. Keď halušky vyplávajú, var ich ešte 2 minúty.
steps.en: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Press the batter through a halušky maker or cut it off a board with a knife straight into the boiling water. When the halušky float, cook them for 2 more minutes.

steps.sk: Halušky sceď dierovanou naberačkou a hneď ich premiešaj s polovicou tuku zo slaniny, aby sa nezlepili. Pridaj tvarohovú zmes a premiešaj, aby sa zohriala.
steps.en: Lift out the halušky with a slotted spoon and toss straight away with half the bacon fat so they do not stick. Add the quark mixture and stir so it warms through.

steps.sk: Rozdeľ ich na taniere, posyp slaninou a pažítkou. Podávaj hneď s kyslým mliekom alebo kefírom, ako sa to na Slovensku pije k haluškám.
steps.en: Divide between plates and sprinkle with the bacon and chives. Serve at once with buttermilk or kefir, which is what Slovaks drink with halušky.

description.sk: Hustý prívarok z bielej fazule na zápražke s octom, majoránom a smotanou.
description.en: A thick white bean stew on a roux with vinegar, marjoram and sour cream.

steps.sk: Fazuľu prepláchni a nechaj odkvapkať. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno. V hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu opekaj 5 minút dozlatista.
steps.en: Rinse and drain the beans. Finely chop the onion. Heat the oil in a pan over a medium heat and fry the onion for 5 minutes until golden.

steps.sk: Posyp ju múkou a opekaj 2 minúty, kým zápražka nezačne voňať, potom pridaj papriku a hneď zalej 500 ml studenej vody. Rozšľahaj, aby nevznikli hrudky, a pridaj bobkový list.
steps.en: Sprinkle with the flour and cook for 2 minutes until the roux smells toasty, then add the paprika and immediately pour in 500 ml of cold water. Whisk to prevent lumps and add the bay leaf.

steps.sk: Pridaj fazuľu, ocot, cukor, soľ, majorán a prelisovaný cesnak a var na miernom ohni 15 minút za občasného miešania, kým omáčka nezhustne a fazuľa nenasiakne chuť.
steps.en: Add the beans, vinegar, sugar, salt, marjoram and crushed garlic and simmer gently for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce thickens and the beans take on the flavour.

steps.sk: Odstav z ohňa a vmiešaj kyslú smotanu – už nevar, smotana by sa zrazila. Ochutnaj, prívarok má byť jemne kyslý; podľa chuti pridaj ocot.
steps.en: Take off the heat and stir in the sour cream; do not boil it again or the cream curdles. Taste: the stew should be gently sour; add vinegar to taste.

steps.sk: Podávaj s chlebom, volským okom alebo opečenou klobásou. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni a odležaním zhustne, preto ho pri ohrievaní zrieď vodou.
steps.en: Serve with bread, a fried egg or a grilled sausage. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days and thickens as it rests, so thin it with water when reheating.

description.sk: Bezmäsité fašírky zo šampiňónov, ovsených vločiek, vajca a syra so zemiakovou kašou.
description.en: Meat-free patties of mushrooms, oats, egg and cheese with mashed potatoes.

steps.sk: Šampiňóny nakrájaj nadrobno alebo ich krátko nasekaj v mixéri na drobné kúsky. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a opeč ju na lyžici oleja 4 minúty, potom pridaj huby a opekaj na vysokom ohni 8 minút, kým sa všetka voda neodparí.
steps.en: Finely chop the mushrooms or pulse them briefly in a processor. Finely chop the onion and fry it in a spoonful of oil for 4 minutes, then add the mushrooms and fry over a high heat for 8 minutes until all the liquid has evaporated.

steps.sk: Huby nechaj vychladnúť. Potom ich zmiešaj s vločkami, vajcami, nastrúhaným syrom, prelisovaným cesnakom, majoránom a polovicou soli. Nechaj 10 minút postáť, aby vločky nasali vlhkosť.
steps.en: Let the mushrooms cool. Then mix them with the oats, eggs, grated cheese, crushed garlic, marjoram and half the salt. Leave for 10 minutes so the oats absorb the moisture.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, uvar v osolenej vode doměkka a roztlač s horúcim mliekom a maslom na hladkú kašu.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, boil them in salted water until tender and mash with the hot milk and butter until smooth.

steps.sk: Mokrými rukami tvaruj zo zmesi 8 placiek hrubých asi 1,5 cm a obaľ ich v strúhanke. Ak sa rozpadávajú, pridaj lyžicu vločiek alebo strúhanky.
steps.en: With wet hands shape the mixture into 8 patties about 1.5 cm thick and coat them in breadcrumbs. If they fall apart, add a spoonful of oats or crumbs.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozpáľ zvyšný olej na strednom ohni a fašírky opekaj 4 minúty z každej strany do zlatohneda. Podávaj so zemiakovou kašou a kyslou uhorkou.
steps.en: Heat the remaining oil in a pan over a medium heat and fry the patties for 4 minutes per side until golden brown. Serve with the mashed potatoes and a pickle.

description.sk: Vianočná rybacia polievka s treskou, koreňovou zeleninou a krutónmi.
description.en: A Christmas fish soup with cod, root vegetables and croutons.

steps.sk: Zeleninu ošúp a nakrájaj na drobné kocky asi 1 cm, cibuľu nadrobno. V hrnci rozpusti maslo a cibuľu opekaj 4 minúty, potom pridaj zeleninu a opekaj ďalšie 3 minúty.
steps.en: Peel the vegetables and dice them into small cubes of about 1 cm, chopping the onion finely. Melt the butter in a pan and fry the onion for 4 minutes, then add the vegetables and fry for another 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Posyp múkou, premiešaj a 1 minútu opekaj. Zalej 1,2 litrom vody s bujónom, pridaj bobkový list a nové korenie a var 15 minút, kým zelenina nezmäkne.
steps.en: Sprinkle with the flour, stir and cook for 1 minute. Pour in 1.2 litres of water with the stock cube, add the bay leaf and allspice and simmer for 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.

steps.sk: Rybu nakrájaj na kúsky veľkosti sústa a vlož ju do polievky. Var na miernom ohni len 5 minút, kým mäso nezbelie a nerozpadá sa na lupienky – dlhším varením by sa rozvarila.
steps.en: Cut the fish into bite-sized pieces and add to the soup. Simmer gently for just 5 minutes until the flesh turns white and flakes; longer cooking would break it up.

steps.sk: Chlieb nakrájaj na kocky a opeč na suchej panvici do chrumkava. Polievku dochuť citrónovou šťavou a soľou, vylov korenie a vmiešaj nasekaný kôpor. Podávaj s krutónmi.
steps.en: Cut the bread into cubes and toast in a dry pan until crisp. Season the soup with lemon juice and salt, fish out the whole spices and stir in the chopped dill. Serve with the croutons.

description.sk: Vegánsky guláš z fazule, zemiakov a papriky s rascou a majoránom.
description.en: A vegan goulash of beans, potatoes and peppers with caraway and marjoram.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a opekaj ju na oleji v hrnci na strednom ohni 8 minút, kým nie je mäkká a zlatistá – cibuľa je základ gulášu, preto sa neponáhľaj.
steps.en: Finely chop the onions and fry them in the oil in a pot over a medium heat for 8 minutes until soft and golden; onion is the base of goulash, so do not rush.

steps.sk: Pridaj rascu, pretlak a obe papriky, krátko premiešaj a hneď podlej 100 ml vody, aby paprika nezhorkla. Pridaj papriku nakrájanú na kocky a zemiaky nakrájané na kocky asi 2 cm.
steps.en: Add the caraway, tomato paste and both paprikas, stir briefly and immediately add 100 ml of water so the paprika does not turn bitter. Add the diced pepper and the potatoes cut into roughly 2 cm cubes.

steps.sk: Zalej 700 ml vody s bujónom a var 20 minút, kým zemiaky nie sú mäkké. Niekoľko kociek zemiakov roztlač o stenu hrnca – guláš tak prirodzene zhustne.
steps.en: Pour in 700 ml of water with the stock cube and simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Crush a few potato cubes against the side of the pot; this thickens the goulash naturally.

steps.sk: Pridaj fazuľu, prelisovaný cesnak, majorán a soľ a var ešte 10 minút. Guláš má byť hustý, ak treba, podlej.
steps.en: Add the beans, crushed garlic, marjoram and salt and simmer for 10 more minutes. The goulash should be thick; add water if needed.

steps.sk: Podávaj s chlebom. Guláš vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť na 3 mesiace.
steps.en: Serve with bread. The goulash keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes for 3 months.

description.sk: Voňavý guláš zo šampiňónov a sušených húb, vegánsky a sýty.
description.en: A fragrant goulash of button and dried mushrooms, vegan and filling.

steps.sk: Sušené huby zalej 300 ml horúcej vody a nechaj 15 minút namočiť. Potom ich vyber, nakrájaj a vodu z nich prelej cez sitko – je plná chuti a pôjde do gulášu.
steps.en: Pour 300 ml of hot water over the dried mushrooms and leave to soak for 15 minutes. Then lift them out and chop them, and strain the soaking water through a sieve; it is full of flavour and goes into the goulash.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a opekaj ju na oleji 8 minút do zlatista. Pridaj šampiňóny nakrájané na štvrtiny a opekaj na vysokom ohni 6 minút, kým nepustia vodu a tá sa neodparí.
steps.en: Finely chop the onions and fry them in the oil for 8 minutes until golden. Add the button mushrooms cut into quarters and fry over a high heat for 6 minutes until they release their liquid and it evaporates.

steps.sk: Pridaj rascu, papriku a pretlak, krátko premiešaj a podlej vodou z húb. Pridaj namočené huby, zemiaky nakrájané na kocky asi 2 cm, 500 ml vody a bujón.
steps.en: Add the caraway, paprika and tomato paste, stir briefly and pour in the mushroom water. Add the soaked mushrooms, the potatoes cut into roughly 2 cm cubes, 500 ml of water and the stock cube.

steps.sk: Var 20 až 25 minút, kým zemiaky nezmäknú a guláš nezhustne. Na konci pridaj prelisovaný cesnak, majorán a soľ a var ešte 2 minúty.
steps.en: Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the goulash has thickened. At the end add the crushed garlic, marjoram and salt and cook for 2 more minutes.

steps.sk: Podávaj s chlebom alebo haluškami. Do krabičiek ho rozdeľ po vychladnutí; v chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Serve with bread or halušky. Pack into boxes once cooled; it keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

description.sk: Plátky zeleru v trojobale, chrumkavé zvonku a mäkké vnútri, so zemiakovým šalátom.
description.en: Breaded celeriac slices, crisp outside and soft inside, with potato salad.

steps.sk: Zeler ošúp a nakrájaj na plátky hrubé asi 1 cm. Var ich v osolenej vode s citrónovou šťavou 6 až 8 minút, kým nezmäknú, ale ešte držia tvar – citrón zabráni stmavnutiu.
steps.en: Peel the celeriac and cut it into slices about 1 cm thick. Boil them in salted water with the lemon juice for 6 to 8 minutes until soft but still holding their shape; the lemon stops them darkening.

steps.sk: Plátky sceď, rozlož na utierku a nechaj vychladnúť a osušiť. Posyp ich zvyšnou soľou a korením.
steps.en: Drain the slices, spread them on a towel and leave to cool and dry. Season with the remaining salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Každý plátok obaľ v múke, rozšľahanom vajci a strúhanke. Obal pritlač dlaňou, aby sa pri vyprážaní neodlupoval.
steps.en: Coat each slice in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs. Press the coating on with your palm so it does not come away when frying.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozpáľ olej na strednom ohni a rezne vyprážaj 3 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé. Vyberaj ich na papierovú utierku.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pan over a medium heat and fry the schnitzels for 3 minutes per side until golden brown. Drain on kitchen paper.

steps.sk: Podávaj so zemiakovým šalátom alebo zemiakmi a citrónom. Majonézu môžeš zmiešať s horčicou na rýchlu omáčku.
steps.en: Serve with potato salad or boiled potatoes and lemon. Mix the mayonnaise with mustard for a quick sauce.

description.sk: Hovädzie závitky plnené slaninou, klobásou, vajcom a uhorkou, dusené v šťave.
description.en: Beef roulades filled with bacon, sausage, egg and pickle, braised in gravy.

steps.sk: Vajcia uvar natvrdo 10 minút a ošúp. Plátky mäsa naklep cez fóliu na hrúbku asi 5 mm, osoľ, okoreň a z jednej strany natri horčicou.
steps.en: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes and peel. Pound the beef slices through film to about 5 mm thick, season with salt and pepper and spread one side with mustard.

steps.sk: Na každý plátok polož plátok slaniny, prúžok klobásy, polovicu vajca, štvrtinu uhorky a trochu nadrobno nakrájanej cibule. Pevne zroluj, boky zahni dovnútra a závitok zopni špáradlami alebo previaž niťou.
steps.en: Lay a slice of bacon, a strip of sausage, half an egg, a quarter of a pickle and a little chopped onion on each slice. Roll up tightly, folding in the sides, and secure with cocktail sticks or kitchen string.

steps.sk: Závitky obaľ v múke a na oleji ich opeč zo všetkých strán na vysokom ohni do hneda, asi 5 minút. Vyber ich, na výpekoch opeč zvyšnú cibuľu dozlatista a pridaj pretlak.
steps.en: Dust the roulades with flour and brown them on all sides in the oil over a high heat, about 5 minutes. Lift them out, fry the remaining onion in the juices until golden and add the tomato paste.

steps.sk: Závitky vráť, podlej 400 ml vody a dus pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 75 až 90 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké. Občas ich otoč a podlej. Medzitým uvar ryžu.
steps.en: Return the roulades, add 400 ml of water and braise, covered, over a low heat for 75 to 90 minutes until the meat is tender. Turn them occasionally and add water if needed. Meanwhile cook the rice.

steps.sk: Závitky vyber, odstráň špáradlá a šťavu zahusti zvyšnou múkou rozmiešanou vo vode, var 3 minúty. Závitky prekroj napoly, aby bolo vidieť plnku, a podávaj s ryžou a šťavou.
steps.en: Lift out the roulades and remove the sticks; thicken the gravy with the remaining flour mixed with water and simmer for 3 minutes. Halve the roulades to show the filling and serve with the rice and gravy.

description.sk: Maďarský hustý paprikový perkelt z bravčového pliecka s cibuľou a paprikou.
description.en: A thick Hungarian paprika stew of pork shoulder with onion and peppers.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a na masti ju opekaj v hrnci na strednom ohni 10 minút, kým nie je mäkká a zlatistá. Mäso nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm.
steps.en: Finely chop the onions and fry them in the lard in a pot over a medium heat for 10 minutes until soft and golden. Cut the pork into roughly 3 cm cubes.

steps.sk: Odstav hrniec, vmiešaj papriku a hneď pridaj mäso – paprika na horúcom tuku bez mäsa by zhorkla. Vráť na oheň a opekaj mäso 5 minút, kým nezbelie zo všetkých strán.
steps.en: Take the pot off the heat, stir in the paprika and add the meat straight away; paprika in hot fat without the meat turns bitter. Return to the heat and fry the meat for 5 minutes until sealed on all sides.

steps.sk: Pridaj rascu, prelisovaný cesnak, papriku a paradajku nakrájané na kocky, väčšinu soli a 200 ml vody. Dus pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 70 až 80 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké. Vody prilievaj len toľko, aby perkelt zostal hustý.
steps.en: Add the caraway, crushed garlic, the diced pepper and tomato, most of the salt and 200 ml of water. Braise, covered, over a low heat for 70 to 80 minutes until the meat is tender. Add only as much water as keeps the stew thick.

steps.sk: Na halušky zmiešaj múku s vajcom, štipkou soli a asi 100 ml vody na husté cesto. Odrezávaj ho z dosky alebo pretláčaj cez haluškovač do vriacej osolenej vody a var 2 minúty po vyplávaní.
steps.en: For the dumplings mix the flour with the egg, a pinch of salt and about 100 ml of water into a thick batter. Cut it off a board or press it through a halušky maker into boiling salted water and cook for 2 minutes after they float.

steps.sk: Halušky sceď a podávaj s perkeltom a kyslou uhorkou. Perkelt vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Drain the dumplings and serve with the stew and a pickle. The stew keeps in the fridge for 4 days and can be frozen.

description.sk: Kuracie prsia plnené šunkou a syrom, obalené a upečené dochrumkava.
description.en: Chicken breasts filled with ham and cheese, breaded and baked until crisp.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Kuracie prsia polož na dosku a ostrým nožom ich z boku nakroj tak, aby vznikla hlboká kapsa – nekrájaj až na koniec, okraje musia zostať spojené.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Lay the chicken breasts on a board and cut a deep pocket into the side of each with a sharp knife, without cutting right through; the edges must stay joined.

steps.sk: Do každej kapsy vlož plátok šunky a syra a okraje pritlač, prípadne zopni špáradlom. Mäso zvonku osoľ a okoreň.
steps.en: Tuck a slice of ham and cheese into each pocket and press the edges together, securing with a cocktail stick if needed. Season the outside with salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Prsia obaľ v múke, rozšľahaných vajciach a strúhanke. Strúhanku najprv opraž na suchej panvici s olejom 3 minúty dozlatista – v rúre tak obal pekne zhnedne aj bez vyprážania.
steps.en: Coat the breasts in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs. Toast the crumbs first in a dry pan with the oil for 3 minutes until golden; that way the coating browns nicely in the oven without frying.

steps.sk: Ulož ich na plech s mriežkou alebo papierom a peč 25 až 30 minút, kým mäso nie je vo vnútri biele a šťava číra (75 °C). Nechaj ich 3 minúty odpočívať, aby syr pri krájaní nevytiekol.
steps.en: Place them on a tray with a rack or baking paper and bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the meat is white inside and the juices run clear (75 °C). Rest for 3 minutes so the cheese does not run out when cut.

steps.sk: Podávaj s citrónom, zemiakmi alebo ryžou a zeleninovým šalátom.
steps.en: Serve with lemon wedges, potatoes or rice and a green salad.

description.sk: Nemecká hustá polievka zo šošovice, zemiakov a koreňovej zeleniny s párkami.
description.en: A thick German soup of lentils, potatoes and root vegetables with frankfurters.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, zeleninu a zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 1 cm. V hrnci zohrej olej a cibuľu opekaj 4 minúty, potom pridaj zeleninu a opekaj ďalšie 3 minúty.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils. Finely chop the onion; peel the vegetables and potatoes and dice them into roughly 1 cm cubes. Heat the oil in a pot and fry the onion for 4 minutes, then add the vegetables and fry for another 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj šošovicu, zemiaky, 1,3 litra vody, bujón a bobkový list. Priveď do varu a var na miernom ohni 30 minút, kým šošovica nie je mäkká a zemiaky sa začínajú rozpadávať.
steps.en: Add the lentils, potatoes, 1.3 litres of water, the stock cube and bay leaf. Bring to the boil and simmer gently for 30 minutes until the lentils are soft and the potatoes are starting to fall apart.

steps.sk: Párky nakrájaj na kolieska a pridaj do polievky na posledných 5 minút, aby sa prehriali. Dlhším varením by popraskali a stratili chuť.
steps.en: Slice the frankfurters and add them to the soup for the last 5 minutes to heat through. Longer cooking makes them split and lose flavour.

steps.sk: Polievku dochuť octom, majoránom a soľou – ocot je v nemeckej šošovicovej polievke dôležitý, zjasní chuť. Bobkový list vylov, posyp petržlenovou vňaťou. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Season the soup with the vinegar, marjoram and salt; vinegar matters in German lentil soup, it brightens the flavour. Remove the bay leaf and sprinkle with parsley. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.en: Hawaiian pork steaks with pineapple and cheese

description.sk: Retro klasika slovenských jedální: plátky so šunkou, ananásom a zapečeným syrom.
description.en: A retro Slovak canteen classic: pork steaks with ham, pineapple and melted cheese.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Plátky mäsa naklep cez fóliu na hrúbku asi 1 cm, okraje nastrihni, aby sa nekrútili, osoľ a okoreň. Ryžu daj variť.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Pound the pork steaks through film to about 1 cm thick, snip the edges so they do not curl and season with salt and pepper. Put the rice on to cook.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozpáľ olej a plátky opekaj na vysokom ohni 2 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé. Prelož ich do zapekacej misy.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the steaks over a high heat for 2 minutes per side until golden brown. Transfer them to a baking dish.

steps.sk: Na každý plátok polož plátok šunky, koliesko ananásu a nastrúhaný syr. Ananás dôkladne osuš, inak by z neho vytiekla šťava a syr by sa nezapiekol.
steps.en: Top each steak with a slice of ham, a pineapple ring and grated cheese. Dry the pineapple well, or its juice runs out and the cheese will not brown.

steps.sk: Zapekaj 12 až 15 minút, kým sa syr neroztopí a nezačne zlatnúť a mäso je prepečené – vo vnútri biele, bez ružovej farby, s čírou šťavou.
steps.en: Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the cheese melts and starts to brown and the meat is cooked through: white inside with no pink and clear juices.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou a šťavou z misy, k tomu zeleninovú oblohu. Najlepšie chutí hneď, kým je syr roztopený.
steps.en: Serve with the rice and the juices from the dish and a side of vegetables. It is best straight away while the cheese is melted.
